; ========================================================================
; EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
; ========================================================================
;
; PLAY.PDM is the "Teach Me!" tutorial lesson player. It displays
; interactive tutorial lessons (.TUT files) that teach users how to
; use each DeskMate application. Despite the name "PLAY", it is NOT
; a music player.
;
; It imports three DeskMate resource modules via INT E0h:
;   - dmguf    (General UI Framework -- menus, dialogs, event loop)
;   - dmplay   (Tutorial playback engine)
;   - unpack   (Data decompression for lesson content)
;
; ========================================================================
; BINARY STRUCTURE
; ========================================================================
;
; MZ + DM89 header (512 bytes)
; DM89 entry point: 01F8:0002 (MSC 5.x CRT startup)
; SS:SP = 0950:1770
;
; Segment Map (4 segments, 14 relocations):
;   seg_0000  0x1F80 bytes  CODE   Main application code + CRT library
;   seg_01F8  0x00A0 bytes  CODE   MSC 5.x CRT startup + far-call stubs
;   seg_0202  0x0040 bytes  DATA   DGROUP fixup area (segment 0202 in relocs)
;   seg_0206  0x0D37 bytes  DATA   String tables, menu defs, lesson list
;
; The code uses a medium memory model: multiple code segments with
; far calls between them, single data group (DGROUP at seg 0202).
;
; ========================================================================
; CRT STARTUP AND _main() IDENTIFICATION
; ========================================================================
;
; CRT entry (__astart):  01F8:0002
;   Signature: mov ah, 30h; int 21h; cmp al, 2; jae +2; int 20h
;   - Checks DOS version >= 2.0 (terminates via INT 20h if older)
;   - Sets SS = 0202 (DGROUP), adjusts SP
;   - Resizes memory block via INT 21h/4Ah
;   - Clears BSS region (0x0D78..0x74E0 in DGROUP)
;   - Calls _cinit, _setargv/_setenvp, then _main
;
; CRT Initialization Flow (via far-call stubs):
;   01F8:0081 -> 0000:1131 -> sub_0000_1150 (_cinit)
;   01F8:0089 -> 0000:1116 which calls:
;     0000:12AC  _setargv   (parse command line)
;     0000:1890  _setenvp   (set up environment pointers)
;     Then pushes envp [0xb82], argv [0xb80], argc [0xb7e]
;     0000:112A  call 0x0191  <-- THIS IS _main()
;     0000:112E  call 0x1214  <-- _exit(retval)
;
; Key CRT Functions:

; DeskMate API USAGE (INT E0h)

;
; The DeskMate API is accessed via INT E0h with function code in AX.
; AH selects the service group, AL the sub-function.
;
; Resource Management (AH=02h):
;   AX=0206h  Load resource module by name
;             DX -> name string ("DMPLAY", "DMGUF", "DMUNPACK", "PRGUF")
;             BX -> far pointer storage for resource handle
;   AX=0207h  Unload resource module
;             DX -> name string
;   AX=0208h  Execute/call resource function
;             DX -> name string, BX -> parameter block
;
; Event/Input (AH=06h):
;   AX=0600h  Get event (poll for keyboard/mouse/timer input)
;   AX=0603h  Resource dispatch (call loaded resource handler)
;   AX=060Eh  Process/dispatch event to application
;
; Timer (AH=07h):
;   AX=0700h  Yield / timer tick processing

; Miscellaneous (AH=21h):
;   AX=2100h  Extended DeskMate function

; ========================================================================
; PROGRAM FLOW
; ========================================================================
;
; 1. CRT startup (01F8:0002)
;    a. DOS version check (>= 2.0)
;    b. Stack/memory setup, BSS clear
;    c. _cinit, _setargv, _setenvp
;
; 2. _main (0000:0191):
;    a. Get current drive and working directory
;    b. Parse command line for .TUT file path
;    c. Change to lesson directory if specified
;    d. Load DeskMate resources (DMPLAY, DMGUF, UNPACK via INT E0h AX=0206h)
;    e. Search for .TUT files on disk
;    f. Display "Teach Me About..." lesson selection dialog
;    g. User interaction loop (arrow keys to select, Enter to run, Esc to exit)
;    h. When lesson selected: load .TUT file, call DMPLAY to execute
;    i. On exit: unload resources (INT E0h AX=0207h), return
;
; 3. Tutorial playback is handled entirely by the DMPLAY resource module.
;    PLAY.PDM is essentially a launcher/menu UI.
